subject.title: fix(slack): add 30s timeout to directory client API calls

question: Should this PR require exact-head failure-path proof for the 30-second timeout and immediate 429 rejection, or should the existing transport tests and healthy live Slack transcript receive a proof override?
rationale: The implementation has no concrete correctness finding, but external-PR policy requires real after-fix behavior proof and only a maintainer can explicitly override that gate.

options.title: Require failure-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted exact-head terminal or live output showing one deliberately stalled Slack request rejecting near 30 seconds and one 429 rejecting promptly.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the focused production-WebClient transport tests and healthy live Slack transcript as sufficient for this low-scope availability change.

recommendation.title: Require failure-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted exact-head terminal or live output showing one deliberately stalled Slack request rejecting near 30 seconds and one 429 rejecting promptly.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the commits defining the final lookup policy and test boundary.
